key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Tall, coarse herb, sometimes several meters tall.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Mostly opposite; large blades commonly palmately 3-lobed, sometimes 5-lobed, with toothed margins.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Male heads in terminal spikes; female heads clustered below.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: very tall ragweed; large 3-lobed opposite leaves; terminal male spikes; larger pyramidal burs
